query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as total, 
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'book' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as livres,
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'article' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as articles,
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type = 'online' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as en_ligne,
       SUM(CASE WHEN entry_type NOT IN ('book', 'article', 'online') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as autres
FROM bibliography_entries;
